newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy March industrial output seen lower - employers.
newsitem.headline: Italy March industrial output seen lower - employers.

text.p: Italian industrial production is seen falling 2.9 percent year-on-year in March, from some 20 working days in March 1997 against 21 a year ago, the employer's body Confindustria said in its latest economic report.
Latest official figures showed Italian industrial production fell 3.1 percent in December year-on-year.
Unadjusted industrial production data for March showed a fall of 6.9 percent, Confindustria added.

The daily average index, stripping out seasonal factors, showed a fall of 0.3 percent in March compared to February. In the first three months of 1997, average industrial production fell 0.1 percent from the previous quarter and some six percent from the first quarter of 1996, Confindustria said.
Sales are seen falling 3.2 percent on a year-on-year basis with domestic demand down 3.4 percent and foreign demand for Italian goods some 2.9 percent lower.
New orders have fallen one percent this month, the survey added.
